'''Onji Shrine''' (恩智神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Onji Nakamachi, Yao, Osaka|ja|恩智中町}}, {{ill|Yao, Osaka|en|Yao, Osaka|qid=Q490872|lt=Yao, Osaka}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|en|Osaka Prefecture|qid=Q122723|lt=Osaka Prefecture}}. It is an ancient shrine recorded as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}) and is traditionally considered the Ninomiya or second Ranked shrine of {{ill|Kawachi Province|en|Kawachi Province|qid=Q1047150|lt=Kawachi Province}}. Under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|ca|Classificació moderna dels santuaris xintoistes|es|Anexo:Santuarios sintoístas según el sistema moderno|fr|Système moderne de classement des sanctuaires shinto|ja|近代社格制度|simple|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|sv|Moderna systemet för rangordning av shinto-helgedomar|zh|近代社格制度|qid=Q712534|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines}}, it was classified as a {{ill|Fu-sha|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Prefectural shrine|ja|府社|qid=Q134917326}}{{efn|lt=Fu-sha|1=Modern_system_of_ranked_Shinto_shrines#Metropolitan_and_Prefectural_Shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q90139226|qq= 近代社格制度}}. The shrine’s {{ill|Shinshi|en|Shinshi|qid=Q10444973|lt=messengers}} are said to be rabbits and dragons.
